name: FedRAMP High & Moderate Baseline Cloud Security Compliance
description: Compliance framework for the Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) Moderate and High Baselines, covering System Security Plans (SSP), FIPS 140-3 validated encryption, Continuous Monitoring (ConMon), Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M), and 3PAO audit assessment.

checklists.name: FedRAMP Security Controls & ConMon Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for FedRAMP Moderate/High baseline security controls and 3PAO assessment readiness.

items.statement: System Security Plan (SSP) narrative explicitly documents control implementation details for all NIST SP 800-53 controls in the baseline.
All encryption endpoints use NIST CMVP FIPS 140-2/3 validated modules for data in transit and data at rest.
Monthly Continuous Monitoring (ConMon) package (OS, container, and DB scan reports) is submitted to FedRAMP PMO.
POA&M entries for High vulnerabilities are resolved and closed within 30 days of discovery.
Third-Party Assessment Organization (3PAO) Security Assessment Plan (SAP) and Security Assessment Report (SAR) are completed.

reviewGates.name: FedRAMP 3PAO Authorization Readiness Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Federal CISO and 3PAO Lead Assessor attest that SSP, FIPS 140-3 cryptography, and ConMon packages satisfy FedRAMP ATO requirements.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the 3PAO Security Assessment Report confirm readiness for FedRAMP Agency or JAB ATO?
